payload.description_html: Life restoration of a single individual of Anchiornis by Sebastian Brandt (Reco-Brandt), exhibited at the National Museum of Natural History, Luxembourg. The model is based on fossil material and represents morphology, plumage and posture of this feathered dinosaur.
